incident: scope violation caused by a too-wide format command
what_happened: A cleanup step ran gofmt -w on the whole internal/domain directory. Two files that belong to previously accepted cards - internal/domain/client_protocol_schema.go and internal/domain/v24_sessions.go - are not gofmt-clean in their accepted form, so the command rewrote 30 lines of pure formatting across them. They are outside this card write_scope.
detection: git status --short showed both files as modified when the checkpoint was being finalised. The diff was verified to be whitespace and struct-tag alignment only (git diff --stat: 30 insertions, 30 deletions, no code change).
remediation: Restored the two files byte-for-byte with git checkout -- limited to exactly those two paths. No blanket checkout, reset or clean was used, and no other file was touched. After the restore the module builds and the construction check still reports PASS with 136 assertions and 0 failures, so nothing in this card depends on the reformatted form.
consequence_for_the_receipt: The reworked receipt states that four out-of-scope files remain gofmt-dirty and were left byte-identical. That sentence is now literally true again; while the reformatted copies existed it was false, and the disclosure file exists so the sequence is recoverable rather than silently corrected.
prevention: Format only named files, never a directory that contains accepted evidence. This incident is also recorded in execution/v2.4/checkpoint.json integrity_events.
